purpose: Paper-only execution lifecycle. This configuration labels entry and recheck phases; it does not tune pricing, probability, sigma, Kelly, or model weights.

revalidation_drift_limits.policy: Initial paper-only revalidation prior. A same-contract quote beyond either limit forces an explicit direction-aware recheck; it never vetoes an entry by itself. The current same-contract paper gate decides eligibility, while the frozen first-write record remains immutable.

price_exhausted_policy: Only classify PRICE_EXHAUSTED when an immutable first-write signal and a later same-contract recheck both exist and the later recheck fails solely because the price no longer passes. Never infer it from a missing quote.
